issues.claim: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/whats-new/csharp-12 (cited for "Since C# 12 lambda parameters can have default values")
issues.problem: The URL redirects to the generic C# version history page. The fetched excerpt covers C# 3 to C# 6 and says nothing about default lambda parameters. The excerpt of the lambda-expressions link also never states which C# version introduced the feature. So the "since C# 12" and "before C# 12 it was a compile error" claims are not shown to be supported by any excerpt. The linkTitle "Что нового в C# 12" / "What's new in C# 12" also no longer matches the page title.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the link with a page that states the version, for example https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/proposals/csharp-12.0/lambda-method-group-defaults (kind: spec), or the C# 12 section of the version history page. Adjust the linkTitles in ru and en to match. Re-fetch to confirm the excerpt names C# 12 and default lambda parameters.

issues.claim: а не `5 + 1` и не сумма с какими-то ещё значениями
issues.problem: The last clause is unnatural filler Russian, and the English version is equally vague about a sum with "any other value".
issues.suggestedFix: Use: "Значение по умолчанию используется, только если аргумент не передан. В вызове `add(5, 10)` второй аргумент передан явно, поэтому результат `5 + 10`, то есть `15`, а не `6`." Align the en text the same way.

issues.claim: Какой тип делегата компилятор выводит для такой лямбды и сохраняется ли в этом типе значение по умолчанию?
issues.problem: The hint is nearly the answer itself: it states that the inferred type may keep the default value. This is a mild giveaway, and the same applies to the en hint.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a weaker nudge, for example: "Можно ли вызвать лямбду, объявленную через `var`, не передавая последний аргумент?" Change the en hint the same way.

issues.claim: Для записи компилятор синтезирует метод клонирования и конструктор копирования
issues.problem: The fetched with-expression excerpt documents the copy constructor but does not show the synthesized clone method. The claim is correct per the C# 9 records spec, but it is not backed by the cited excerpt. The same applies to the en explanation.
